desc:
Welcome to the tower where slime is rising up!

Escape from the slime and clear the tower!
The color of the knife changes for each tower!
Let's clear a lot of levels, win streak, and earn victory points!

🎉 Thank you for 400,000 visits! 🎉

]

The creator isn't very good at Orby, so it might be easier.
